question: GQ-001
subject: my new gate broke the suite that proves gates are load-bearing
how_it_surfaced: the pre-push hook REFUSED the push — second real enforcement event today — with BASELINE FAILED: the chain does not pass on a clean copy

the_cause.what: the load-bearing suite runs the chain on a scratch copy with exactly ONE synthetic commit
the_cause.effect: every worklog add-commit is "just now", so all 44 worklogs written today showed hours of drift
the_cause.result: my new --strict gate fired 44 times on a repo with no defect at all

why_it_is_the_gate_that_should_change: the suite already EXCLUDES evaluate-refresh for exactly this reason; an exclusion list is a thing callers forget, and I did. Better for the gate to detect synthetic history itself.
the_fix: skip the timestamp check when git history has fewer than 10 commits, and SAY SO as an info finding rather than passing silently

a_second_defect_the_first_fix_exposed.why: they carry file="metrics/2026-08-04-....json" and path="session.commits" — a JSON POINTER, not a filesystem path — and my isHistorical read path first
a_second_defect_the_first_fix_exposed.shape: the same wrong-key class that lib/claim-paths.mjs and lib/snapshot-paths.mjs were built for

verified_four_ways.real_repo: exit 0, 25 historical findings reported not gated
